# `/oauth-clients` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /oauth-clients/v1

`listOauthClientsV1` — List oauth clients

This gets a list of OAuth clients.

- Scopes: sp:oauth-client:manage, sp:oauth-client:read
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: lastUsed: le, isnull — e.g. `lastUsed le 2023-02-05T10:59:27.214Z`
- Returns 200: array of getoauthclientresponse

### POST /oauth-clients/v1

`createOauthClientV1` — Create oauth client

This creates an OAuth client.

- Scopes: sp:oauth-client:manage
- Body (application/json): createoauthclientrequest
- Returns 200: createoauthclientresponse

### GET /oauth-clients/v1/{id}

`getOauthClientV1` — Get oauth client

This gets details of an OAuth client.

- Scopes: sp:oauth-client:manage, sp:oauth-client:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The OAuth client id
- Returns 200: getoauthclientresponse

### DELETE /oauth-clients/v1/{id}

`deleteOauthClientV1` — Delete oauth client

This deletes an OAuth client.

- Scopes: sp:oauth-client:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The OAuth client id
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /oauth-clients/v1/{id}

`patchOauthClientV1` — Patch oauth client

This performs a targeted update to the field(s) of an OAuth client.

- Scopes: sp:oauth-client:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The OAuth client id
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: getoauthclientresponse
